rules.name: Derive state or province from location
rules.statement: When the ZIP or postal code changes and a matching state or province can be determined from the available options, select it. The applicant can change the selection.

rules.name: Handle location derivation against eligible-only options
rules.statement: When eligible-only presentation is enabled and a ZIP/postal code of at least five trimmed characters cannot be resolved against current options, clear the selected state and show location feedback.
